key.name: enabled
key.description: Master switch for the island overlay.

key.name: clipboard-enabled
key.description: Show the island when text or an image is copied.

key.name: clipboard-min-size
key.description: Texts shorter than this do not trigger the island.

key.name: screenshot-enabled
key.description: Show the island when a new screenshot appears in the Pictures/Screenshots folder.

key.name: screen-edge
key.description: Edge of the screen where the island rests: left, right, top or bottom.

key.name: auto-hide-timeout
key.description: Seconds the island stays visible before fading out (0 disables).

key.name: island-opacity
key.description: Base opacity of the island surface (0.1 - 1.0).
